title_zh: 香格里拉:雪山下的梯田与村落
title_en: Beautiful Places in China (18/20): Shangri-La, Terraced Fields and Villages Below the Snow Peaks
note_en: 之所以…是因为… explains a fact by first stating the result and then the reason: 这个地方之所以叫香格里拉，是因为当地政府在二零零一年正式用了这个名字 "The reason this place is called Shangri-La is that the local government officially adopted the name in 2001." It is the reverse of the everyday 因为…所以… order and sounds bookish, much like English "The reason X is that Y"; 之所以 always sits after the subject, never before it, as in Xiao Zhou's closing thought 这个地方之所以让人念念不忘.
